text:
alex: Heads up folks — offsite transport poll: wholl take the train vs drive vs rent? Trying to coordinate a carpool.
marta: Train for me. more productive time and less hassle with parking.
jo: Driving from SF, happy to take one extra person if it helps. I have a medium SUV.
pat: Whats the luggage situation? I have a poster tube and a rolling suitcase.
transport-bot: Reminder: Parking at venue is limited to 40 spots. First-come, first-served. Daily rate $18.
sam: If youre driving, can we split tolls/parking via Venmo? 
alex: Yep I can split. If Jo takes 2 people that reduces total cars. Whos in for carpool with Jo? react with :car: if you want a ride.
marta: :train: for me but I can take the 1pm train if someone wants earlier.
jo: Leaving SF at 8am, can pickup near 101/16th if that helps.
pat: car emoji 697 (count me in). Ill fit the poster tube behind the seats or roof rack if needed.
sam: Ill take the train if Jo cant do the poster, else carpool.
alex: Quick packing reminder for carpoolers:
```
- soft bags preferred (fit in trunk)
- label fragile items
- bring a small blanket for longer drives
- keep one person as bags-in-charge
```
pat: Also: keep sunscreen + water in glovebox for road pitstops.
transport-bot: If you book rental car on Redwood pro account, use code RED-TRIP for 10% off.
jo: Plan: I'll take three seats. Can pick up @pat @alex. Leaving 8:00, meet at 7:45 at 101/16th. Sound good?
marta: Sounds good, have fun y44b
alex: Thanks! I'll Venmo for tolls/parking later.
pat: Thanks Jo! saving a seat for the poster.
transport-bot: FYI: Add your travel plan to the offsite spreadsheet so leads can track arrival windows.
